Environment: GitHub Windows 2022 (2 cores), Direct2D on WARP (Microsoft Basic Render Driver); no RTX3060 performance claim
Workflow: cache-development, job windows, steps FileLeaseChecks / CacheChecks / HostCacheProbe --integration / HostCacheProbe --preview-performance

Fixtures.base: one shape per frame and one Arial text item (the 5 Arial font files are the frame's file dependencies)
Fixtures.files24: base shapes, 120 more shapes, one Arial text item and 24 audio items with distinct WAV files (29 file dependencies per frame)

Before.Note: main 23e4fdb plus a file-open counter (FileDependencyLease.FileOpens) and a behaviour-preserving extraction of the idle helpers (CreateBatchSource, PrimeFrame); IdleCacheOrder moved to its own file

LineFormat: PERF|fixture|mode|frame=p50/p95/p99/max/mean (ms, Update+Draw on the test's render thread)|stage=p50/p95/mean ...|opens/frame=files opened by the plugin per frame
Extraction: lines copied from the job logs, timestamps removed; the parent-directory-rename line exists only after the fix (the check was added with it)

DrawOnce.Note: one run, drawn-once (cold-store*) and drawn-twice (cold-store-twice*) passes alternated via TimelineFrameCache.DrawOnce; -paced passes wait for the GPU after each frame; WALL lines are the console ms/frame including that wait

Fixtures.effects: per frame three blurred shapes at 600% zoom and one blurred Arial text item

Stabilize.Note: readback ring (3 per source), pooled readback textures, reused display command list, at least two rotating targets, persistent idle renderer; the harness collects the heap before each pass from cf7f4e1 on. Each run alternates drawn-once (cold-store*) and drawn-twice (cold-store-twice*) passes in three pairs; WALL lines are the console ms/frame including the paced GPU wait
Stabilize.Missing: stabilize-55ec3e4-run1.txt lacks the first four base passes (off, cold-store, cold-store-twice, cold-store-twice-2): the log was read from its tail
Stabilize.Fields: once=frames shown drawn once, busy=frames not stored because every readback slot was waiting on the GPU, created=readback textures created in the pass, gcpause=ms of GC pause in the pass, ws=working set MB, pool=pooled readback MB

Refactor.Note: no behavior change; the fastest runner of the series (base/off p50 0.66 ms): unpaced base passes skipped 6-15 stores in both modes because every readback slot was waiting on WARP, paced passes stored every frame
